analysis.title: Occidental Petroleum Corp. (OXY): Takeaways from Houston: Self-Help Story On Track; Maintain Buy (on Conviction List)
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on OXY (on the Conviction List) and cuts its 12-month price target to $75 from $76. The price was $56.52, implying 32.7% upside. The call follows meetings in Houston with the CEO, CFO and Investor Relations.

GS sees OXY as one of the best self-help stories, with $4 billion of cash flow uplift by 2029 from operating cost reductions, interest savings and improved decline rates. The view assumes a long-term $75 Brent and $70 WTI oil price.
OXY generated about $2.8 bn of FCF in 3Q26 on stronger-than-expected production and continued capital discipline.

OXY reached its $10.0 bn principal debt milestone and set a new $6.0 bn target. Management expects to hit it during 2027 at mid-cycle or current strip pricing. GS models YE2027 using $80/bbl Brent and $3.00/MMBtu Henry Hub in 2027.

At the $6.0 bn principal debt target, OXY expects leverage of about 1.0x at $50/bbl WTI and annual interest expense of about $400 mn, roughly $1.0 bn below 2025 levels. Management sees this as the step toward dividend growth and broader shareholder returns.
Management plans to evaluate opportunistic buybacks after reaching $6.0 bn, ahead of the preferred equity redemption in August 2029.

GS wants more clarity on 2027 capital spending versus the $5.9 bn starting point messaged earlier this year. The preliminary outlook includes peak Horn Mountain waterflood spending and modest exploration in Trinidad and Tobago, Peru and Colombia.

Advanced recovery is progressing. Conventional EOR sidetracks and horizontal wells added about 10 Mboe/d by end of 3Q26 (front page) and about 11 Mbo/d (body text). Management has identified about 500 more sidetrack opportunities and still expects 100 sidetracks completed by year-end 2026.
OXY agreed to secure about 2 MTPA of lower-cost CO2 for Permian EOR, with potential to expand to about 4 MTPA. CO2 and power are about 30% of the cost of an EOR barrel.

3Q26 production was 697/1,427 Mboe/d (oil/total), about 7 Mboe/d above the guidance midpoint on U.S. onshore strength. Gulf of America lost 9 Mboe/d to a third-party gas pipeline outage and extended maintenance.
4Q26 oil production guidance of about 694-713 Mbo/d is below GS and FactSet consensus. It reflects the Gulf of America pipeline constraint and downtime from an early-October hurricane.
Midstream and marketing earned $309 mn adjusted pre-tax income in 3Q26, helped by higher sulfur prices and volumes at Al Hosn. OXY guides to $100-$200 mn of pre-tax midstream income in 4Q26.
STRATOS retains startup execution risk while OXY completes structural repairs and commissioning. Management expects full plant startup around year-end 2026 and $90-$130 mn of project EBITDA in 2028.
GS now values OXY on 2028 FCF at $75/bbl Brent, versus average 2027/2028 FCF at about $78/bbl Brent before. This drives the target cut. Target FCF yield is 10.0% with $3.50/MMBtu Henry Hub.
The $75 target blends an 85% weight on a fundamental value of about $73 with a 15% weight on an M&A value of about $84, using an M&A rank of 2.
Estimate changes: 2026E EPS rises to $7.30 from $6.85, 2027E falls to $4.67 from $4.79, 2028E rises to $4.39 from $4.21. 2026E EBITDA is $17.79 bn versus $17.67 bn prior.

market_movers.rationale: Buy reiterated and kept on the Conviction List, with the target cut from $76. GS cites faster deleveraging and growing sustainable cash flow, with $4 billion of cash flow uplift by 2029.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported: FCF of about $2.8 bn, oil/total production of 697/1,427 Mboe/d (about 7 Mboe/d above guidance midpoint), midstream and marketing adjusted pre-tax income of $309 mn.
4Q26 guidance (company): oil production about 694-713 Mbo/d, below GS/FactSet consensus. Pre-tax midstream income $100-$200 mn.
GS estimates (not reported): EPS (diluted, pre-except) of $7.30 for 2026E, $4.67 for 2027E and $4.39 for 2028E, versus 2025 reported $2.23. Prior GS estimates were $6.85, $4.79 and $4.21.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: $1.93 for 9/26, $1.89 for 12/26E, $1.12 for 3/27E and $1.08 for 6/27E.

macro_indicators.interpretation: With $3.00/MMBtu Henry Hub, this price lets OXY reach its $6.0 bn principal debt target by YE2027 in GS's model.

trade_ideas.description: Long OXY, Buy rating on the Conviction List, 12-month price target $75
trade_ideas.rationale: Accelerated deleveraging and growing sustainable cash flow give a clearer path to broader shareholder returns, with $4 billion of cash flow uplift by 2029.
trade_ideas.risk: Higher operating costs, negative well results, weak production/capex execution, lower commodity prices and government pronouncements.

risk_factors: Higher operating costs, negative well results, weak production and capex execution, lower commodity prices and government pronouncements (GS key risks).
Gulf of America production constraint from a third-party gas pipeline that extends into 4Q26, plus early-October hurricane downtime.
STRATOS startup execution risk while structural repairs and commissioning are completed.
Limited clarity on 2027 capital spending versus the $5.9 bn starting point.
